location.ref: Paltū Sāhib's verses against outer worship

paraphrase: Paltū mocks the one who bathes at pilgrim places and worships stones while his heart is full of deceit; the Lord is found by the one who turns within and hears the unstruck sound.
speaker: Paltū
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Thematic summary; no single verse recalled.
